archetypes.name: dyn-routing-parity
archetypes.rationale: Bootstrap, dispatch, and launcher must resolve the same effective difficulty and model defaults.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed Step 2 routing path from bootstrap through dispatch and the Cursor launcher. Verify explicit coder and model overrides still win, invalid difficulty falls back safely, and MODERATE alone selects Cursor with grok-4.5. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
